notes.title: GDC 2017 Schedule
notes.content:
GoatPunks is coming to GDC thanks to Intel. I'll be demoing GoatPunks at these places:

- GDC Prototype/Playtest Night
28th February, 7pm - 10pm

- Game Night with Kickstarter and Game Jolt
2nd March, 8pm - 10pm

- GDC Intel Booth 
3rd March, 10am - 3pm

- Online multiplayer stages unlocked on proceeding to next stage

notes.title: Software Update 0.23 - Released
notes.content:
Thanks for all the early feedback, stay tuned for updates in the next few days. Your input will definitely help make GoatPunks the best it can be.

Updates: 
- beginner, advanced, and king difficulty settings.
- ninja punk skill fixed
- bombs active only at target and not when falling.
